question: Which registered cleanup bodies belong in B, C or product composition?
procedure: Search all production C/H references to compat_host_context_register and session_register_teardown; read the five F registrations and cleanup bodies, session disposal, B registry disposal and the existing B mapping cleanup.

observations.scope: Explicit source call sites, not an exhaustive runtime callback trace or macro-generated call proof
observations.current_order: session_dispose_with_reason rejects bound threads and armed termination, calls compat_host_context_dispose in reverse registration order, clears presentation text, ends guest memory, then zeros the session. The standalone worker additionally ends memory before its final session disposal; consumers must preserve the actual caller-specific sequence.

rows.actual_work: Unlinks the owner's capture pointer, securely clears capture state, frees its heap allocation. Does not wait for or complete a child request.
rows.destination: B capture resource with B-owned slot/context; F selects admission and lifetime
rows.requirements: Preserve owner generation, single active capture, heap ownership, secure clearing and registration-failure rollback. Do not weaken session_valid by mechanically replacing it with the narrower B validity predicate.
rows.status: ownership resolved; complete capture/access migration design pending

rows.actual_work: Clears owner slot and frees numeric DOSWOW registration. Same file separately decodes C DOSWOWDATA and CDS using guest memory.
rows.destination: B numeric registration and lifetime; C private structure interpretation
rows.requirements: Retain lock, context/memory generations, registration before FDC workers and no live-bound-thread disposal. Split private layout access rather than importing DOS headers into B.
rows.status: split ownership resolved; memory-provider boundary pending

rows.actual_work: Closes temporary INI handle, deletes temporary path and zeros state. Creation copies selected system.ini and retains delete-on-close handle; failure disposes partially built state.
rows.destination: B temporary profile-copy resource and existing package-path capability
rows.requirements: C wkernel.c uses this through W32PrivateProfileFileName, falling back to the supplied filename on failure. Preserve that observable failure behavior. package_layout.c supplies both process-derived and explicit roots; do not silently substitute current-image root for explicit-root callers. Preserve owner association and reuse of the same copy.
rows.caller_evidence: Production C/H call search finds mvdm_standalone_worker.c using set_process_media_roots. Explicit set_media_roots callers are in test/app/package_layout_fixture.c; no production explicit-root caller found. The fixture exercises path derivation and validation, not an alternative product media selection.
rows.status: ownership and source callers resolved; final context carrier and compile/link selection reconciliation pending

rows.actual_work: Clears F console slot and COMMAND binding, stops publisher/input watcher, closes transport/capabilities, disposes NTCON channel and graphics resources.
rows.destination: F product composition; generic resource implementations remain inward
rows.requirements: Do not move worker-base publication, NTCON transport or command routing into B. Replace registration of this product callback in B with explicit outer-owned cleanup when the complete initialization/failure/disposal chain is restructured; preserve partial-start cleanup and producer-stop ordering.
rows.status: F policy confirmed; explicit outer teardown design pending

rows.actual_work: Leaves protected paging, retires original-layout USER storage, stops clock, releases VDM allocations and mappings, disposes clock and zeros domain.
rows.destination: C machine/private-layout domain; B clock and independent storage mechanics; F startup/disposal timing
rows.requirements: Preserve stop-clock-before-unmap, original VDM allocation ownership, retired borrow handling and protected-mode transition. Do not place the whole callback in B behind CPU/SAS function pointers. Candidate C placement and mirror cost require complete domain review and approval if net diff increases.
rows.status: split ownership resolved; C carrier and full domain design pending

rows.actual_work: Two registration sites share one callback; removes B-owned numeric mapping/alias records and frees allocations.
rows.requirements: Keep owner isolation and existing cleanup ordering with C mappings; this callback does not call a product provider.

design_constraint: Do not add a second generic cleanup registry. Use explicit product cleanup in F, B resource disposal for B objects and C domain teardown for machine objects. Preserve dependency ordering across those operations instead of mechanically partitioning the current LIFO list.
verification: Source-only architecture review; no production mutation, build, runtime test or new release. No dependency ID closed and mirror delta zero.
follow_up: Complete the remaining four-component inventory, resolve explicit-root call sites and C page-domain carrier, then implement the coupled context and teardown changes with lifecycle/failure tests.
